_doc: Hand-kept content of the MTS Control Room page (scripts/dev/make_control_room.py). Edit HERE, never the page. Process: MyTradingSys/system/CONTROL_ROOM.md. Item ids: registry rows (B/T), bigtrade findings (F-BT-NN), or X- road tasks defined below. When an X- task gets a registry row, replace the X- id with the row id.
verdict: The system runs and trades on testnet, but no source has shown a real edge after fees. Current step: Stage 1, trustworthy measurements. Several data bugs mean today's 'no edge' verdicts cannot be trusted either way.

road.name: Trustworthy measurements
road.goal: Every number a backtest or the live engine reads is correct. Until this holds, every 'no edge' verdict is suspect.
road.exit: B146-B148 closed; volume profile, naked POC and OI fixes live; backtests re-run on fixed data.

road.name: Survive the fees
road.goal: Stops wide enough that a 1m wick does not hit them and fees cost a small fraction of R.
road.exit: fee_R under 0.25 R on Tom and every traded layer; maker entries modelled and tested.

road.name: Find a real edge
road.goal: At least one source shows net-positive expectancy out of sample, after fees, on fixed data.
road.exit: Walk-forward (backtest D) net R > 0 with CI above 0 for at least one Tom or layer config.

road.name: Prove it on testnet
road.goal: The winning configs trade on testnet with real exits, enough trades, the stack up around the clock.
road.exit: 200+ trades from S3 configs, net positive, under 5 % of exits by time-out, uptime over 95 %.

road.name: Go-live gate
road.goal: A written bar for real money, agreed by the operator, met by S4 numbers.
road.exit: Operator signs the bar; S4 meets it for 30 days.

X-MAKER: Maker execution model: limit entry and target, taker only on the stop (P1 showed adverse selection +0.02 bp vs ~10 bp fee)
X-BTD: Backtest D: walk-forward tuning of stop_buffer_atr per layer and Tom, report fee_R per cell, label BT-TUNED
X-RERUN: Re-run the capture matrix and Tom backtest after Stage 1 fixes land
X-RSI1H: Lead: rsi_events 1h, 3 of 3 live wins (+9.75 USD); needs a full-history check
X-ESC1H: Lead: fabio escalation 1h, best lift in the capture matrix (1.24-1.38 at 24 bars, small n)
X-EXITS: 97 % of testnet trades end on the time exit: targets and stops are almost never reached
X-GATE: Write the go-live bar for real money (proposal is decision D06 on the page)

evidence.result: Gross -0.15 R before fees (CI -0.29 to +0.04); live rule now finds 0 signals where an older run found 19
0 of 34 reach lift 1.15 at 96 bars; most sit at 1.00 (no better than chance)
0 net-positive out of sample; gross +0.13 R, fees cost 0.66 R
Adverse selection +0.02 bp against a ~10 bp fee: maker fills are realistic
8 h window passes; 4 h and 12 h fail sign stability
92-100 % after switching backtests to spot data (was 0-70 % on perp)

health_notes.d: dark ~23 of the last 120 h; 2-day gap 09-30..10-02 (F-BT-19)
fatal hardware error every 1-3 days since July, SMART unread (B140)
